description: Search components, charts, blocks, templates, patterns and hooks by what you need, for example 'date picker', 'pricing section', 'stacked bar chart', 'modal', 'confirm before delete' or 'debounce'. Common synonyms are understood. Returns the best matches with install commands.

type.description: Only return this kind of item: component, chart, block (a page section), template (a whole page), pattern (a scenario built from components, such as a confirm-delete flow) or hook (a React hook).
